title: Keep: pinned upstream schemas; missing oracle fails
description:
tests/trqp/conftest.py:1-25, :133-187; tests/trqp/test_trqp.py:244-288, :577-584. The conformance oracle is the upstream Trust Task JSON schemas, copied verbatim and pinned to a commit. A missing jsonschema or referencing fails the run instead of skipping it. The oracle is itself guarded: test_spec_invalid_payloads_fail_the_schema proves the validator rejects the spec's own invalid examples. The resource vectors are ported from vgi-core resource.rs's unit tests, not derived from is_resource.

Do NOT change this to pytest.importorskip, regenerate the expected values from the bridge, or replace the schemas with hand-written assertions. Each of those would turn the suite into the code under test acting as its own oracle.
